tools.name: prepare_action
tools.description: Find an available business tool for the requested intent. Returns one selected input schema, missing fields, an ambiguity or no match. Does not execute business actions. To resolve an ambiguity, call again with operation_id, operation_revision, tool_choice and all known_arguments. Never invent identifiers or credentials. Operations expire after 15 minutes.

known_arguments.description: JSON object. Apply tg-jsonschema-1 value/byte/depth restrictions; no coercion or implicit merge.

tools.name: execute_read_action
tools.description: Execute a previously prepared read-only operation. Send its operation_id, latest operation_revision and complete arguments. Never use for writes. Missing or invalid arguments are returned together. Approval and authorization remain with the provider.

arguments.description: JSON object. Apply tg-jsonschema-1 value/byte/depth restrictions; no coercion or implicit merge.

tools.name: execute_write_action
tools.description: Execute a previously prepared action that may modify, delete or disclose data. Requires provider authorization and any required approval for the exact selected tool and arguments. Do not assume preparing an operation is approval. Unknown-effect tools also use this entry point.

arguments.description: JSON object. Apply tg-jsonschema-1 value/byte/depth restrictions; no coercion or implicit merge.

workflow_tools.name: prepare_workflow
workflow_tools.description: Select the tools needed for a multi-step business workflow, including discovery prerequisites. Returns up to eight independent operations and their input schemas. Does not execute. Use real prior tool results to fill IDs and order dependent steps. Each operation may execute only once with one argument set. Prepare again only for missing tools or a fresh invocation; never replace an uncertain execution.
